_about: Seed listings for the Vanderbilt demo campus (backend/seed/seed.py). Each listing names its photo files in this folder, in order (first = feed card, kind front; then back, label, other). To swap in real photos, follow README.md in this folder. `owner` is the part of a seed account's email before @vanderbilt.edu (see USERS in seed.py). `hours_ago` is when the listing was posted, relative to the moment the seed runs. Sizes follow the IOS-2 vocabulary in docs/API.md.

listings.title: Vintage two-tone quarter-zip pullover
